create_eval_runner: create an EvalRunner instance with a dataloader, EvalUnit, and optional callbacks for evaluation
run_eval_runner: run the EvalRunner to execute evaluation using torchtnt's evaluate function with the configured dataloader
configure_eval_callbacks: configure an EvalRunner with a list of Callback objects to trigger during evaluation
set_max_steps_per_epoch: set the max_steps_per_epoch parameter on EvalRunner to limit evaluation steps per epoch
review_eval_runner_class: review the EvalRunner class that wraps torchtnt evaluate with dataloader, callbacks, and step limits
